text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Mile Championship is here. Not only do we have Daiichi Ruby to contend with, but Daitaku Helios is running as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her rivals' winds will block Yamanin Zephyr's progress, but if she remains a strong wind herself, she should be able to blow right past them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her spirit blazing with determination, she prepares to put in an astonishing performance in the race ahead.
